what_this_is: Frozen certification thresholds for stable-envs renderers. Normative prose lives in docs/research/certification.md; this file is the machine-readable copy so a later step can map a benchmark JSON to a certification label without re-reading the document. Every number here was derived from the committed benchmark corpus BEFORE any fresh RTX 3090 or Apple-M5 measurement; a later result is not a reason to change it.

backend_classes.assignment: from the `backends` field that scratch/census/census.py records per class

device_scaling.basis: memory bandwidth; the fused rasterizer is documented output-bandwidth-bound
device_scaling.status: PREDICTION, pre-registered. Knowingly pessimistic for HOST_BOUND rows. Step 3 reports the factor it measures; the thresholds do not move.

metrics.R: stable-envs GPU fps at best certified batch / official CPU renderer fps, same host
metrics.cores: stable-envs GPU fps at best certified batch / one-core JPEG-q90 decode fps of this env's own frame, same host

batch_4096_feasible.note: every currently-measured env fits B=4096 on a 24 GB RTX 3090

tier_anchors.rule: GPU_FASTER floor = class p25, GPU_FAST floor = class median, GPU_EXCEPTIONAL floor = class p75, of the PREDICTED RTX 3090 R distribution, rounded down to a round number
tier_anchors.cores_conjunct_basis: docs/research/when_does_this_pay_off.md G4: regeneration must beat decode. cores >= 1 is the G4 bar; cores >= 10 is one order past it.

no_reference_fallback.when: no installable official renderer in any interpreter; R is undefined and must not be fabricated

BATCH_SCALES.basis: set below the observed minimum across 129 corpus rows (22.8x) so it fails only a renderer that is not actually batching; a per-frame loop scores about 1x

NO_LARGE_BATCH_REGRESSION.basis: 1 of 129 corpus rows sits between 0.9 and 1.0 (Roundabout, 0.93)

HOST_BOUND.consequence: the row measures this node's processor under this node's load, not the device; report thread count and load average; never quote as a device capability or compare across nodes

BELOW_G4.consequence: capped at GPU_FASTER regardless of R

metrics.S_cpu: stable-envs CPU fps / official CPU renderer fps, same host, same thread budget, same resolution and supersample; reported at the 1-thread budget
metrics.cores_cpu: stable-envs CPU fps / one-core JPEG-q90 decode fps of this env's own frame

tier_anchors.rule: percentiles of the G4-on-CPU break-even distribution = (one-core decode fps / official CPU renderer fps), over the 187 rows of examples/results/decode/ALL.json carrying both

mapping.CPU_PARITY_floor_1: slower than the renderer you replaced is a regression by definition

cpu.critical_rule: device="cpu" returning a frame assigns NO tier. Support (Gate A) and speed (Gate C) are different claims. The tier stays CPU_UNMEASURED.

no_reference_fallback.when: no installable official renderer in any interpreter; S_cpu is undefined and must not be fabricated
no_reference_fallback.basis: the primary ladder's own spacing applied from the G4 bar: CPU_FAST is 2.5x the CPU_FASTER floor and CPU_EXCEPTIONAL is 4x CPU_FAST, so 1 -> 2.5 -> 10, rounded to 1 / 3 / 10. Far below the GPU NO_REFERENCE ladder of 1 / 10 / 100 because on GPU a whole device competes with one core of decode, while here one core competes with one core.
no_reference_fallback.needed_because: section 12.2 makes CPU_FAST mandatory for ENVIRONMENT_DONE, so without this an env whose upstream package cannot be installed could never be finished

representation_tripwire.purpose: regression detector for optimization passes; never a substitute for the downstream gate

near_exact_fast_step.basis: classic control measures 3.3e-16 to 4.4e-13 over 100 steps and <= 2.2e-16 after one; the bounds sit ~2000x above the worst observed value and far below anything physically meaningful

approximate_fast_step.basis: PushT measures control 9.5e-05 and block median 0.68 px against a mean of 20.7

complete_requires: every SWM leaf classified as identical / renamed / scaled / swm_only
check_variations_do_something and check_colors_apply_exactly pass on every visual leaf

coupled_high_risk.definition: one leaf changes both visual geometry and physics/collision geometry
extra_requirements: applied to reference simulator and renderer from the same value in the same call, no independent default on either side
state-sufficiency check after the variation is applied, not only at the default

downstream.design: paired: same checkpoint, episodes, seeds, start steps, goal offsets, planner seed and reference physics; only render() differs
downstream.test: TOST-style equivalence on the paired success-rate difference; a non-significant p-value is NOT evidence of equivalence
downstream.ci_formula: delta +/- 1.96 * sqrt(b + c) / n, in percentage points
downstream.pass_condition: the two-sided 95% CI on delta lies entirely within +/- 5 points AND the control arm degraded
margin_justification: seed-to-seed spread of the OFFICIAL PushT arm alone is 80-96% (16 points); 5 is under a third of that
at n=300 and the observed 23/300 discordance the 95% half-width is 3.13 points, so a real 5-point degradation is detected rather than absorbed

conditional.when: any visual-tier renderer is to be advertised as downstream-certified
conditional.rationale: neither required arm is visual tier, so the pair cannot license a semantic claim about visual renderers

representative_environments.pushT_why: class R, parity, approximate_fast_step available separately, contact-heavy, VariationMap complete, evaluation demonstrated pixel-sensitive by the blank-frame control
representative_environments.reacher_why: class S complement: mjwarp+raycast3d, 3-D MuJoCo, reference_only physics, parity tier; registered default is reacher-hard (measured, not assumed); 3 wrapper tasks collapse to 2 render-distinct configs and both are covered; cpu_frac 2.95 makes it HOST_BOUND and therefore a good methodology stress case

ladder.advertised_target_exemption_note: There is no exemption. An env does not become ENVIRONMENT_DONE by declining to advertise CPU; CPU is a first-class target, so CPU_REGRESSION means half-finished, not finished. The only relief is the NO_REFERENCE fallback of the GPU/CPU spec, which changes the metric and not the bar.

backend_certified_partial_requires.note: identical to BACKEND_CERTIFIED(device) except that registered_default_coverage == partial
backend_certified_partial_requires.terminal_note: benchmarkable, conformance-tested, SWM-usable, may carry any performance tier including GPU_EXCEPTIONAL; there is simply no edge from here to ENVIRONMENT_DONE

ladder.invariant: Gate A = partial can never produce ENVIRONMENT_DONE.
ladder.invariant_note: BACKEND_CERTIFIED_PARTIAL(cpu) + BACKEND_CERTIFIED_PARTIAL(gpu) does not compose into ENVIRONMENT_DONE. No throughput number retires a declared exclusion from the registered default observation.

pure_implementation.downstream_waiver_condition: outputs bit-identical or within the existing declared fidelity contract, render-model signature unchanged, and the representation tripwire unmoved

visual_approximation.note: lowering a declared parity_interior_min or visual_fidelity floor is a TIER CHANGE, not an optimization

config_changes_that_void_gate_a: the registered SWM default the env is certified against

modes.mode_is_part_of_certification_identity: GPU_FAST earned under render_quality=fast is recorded as GPU_FAST@fast and does not transfer to reference

excluded_from_denominator.why: they produce no frame, so there is nothing for a renderer to cover
